name: Al Jazeera
body: Its JSON-LD names a NewsMediaOrganization and marks speakable text for voice assistants. Yet robots.txt disallows ChatGPT-User and PerplexityBot, which fetch pages to cite them in AI answers. GEO: 64.
lesson: Decide crawler by crawler. Training bots and answer bots are separate user-agents, so each can get its own rule.
summary: www.aljazeera.com scores 84 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 14 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: 2 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 2 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 15 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: OneTrust is present but Google Consent Mode defaults were not found
fix.evidence: Without Consent Mode v2 defaults, Google tags can fire before the visitor chooses, and Google Ads loses modelled conversions.
